scripts.pack: for p in crows-backgrounds crows-traits crows-weapons crows-armor crows-gear crows-consumables crows-ammunition crows-spellbooks crows-monsters crows-loot crows-rules; do npx fvtt package pack -n $p --in src/packs/$p --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows || exit 1; done
scripts.pack:backgrounds: fvtt package pack -n crows-backgrounds  --in src/packs/crows-backgrounds  --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:traits: fvtt package pack -n crows-traits       --in src/packs/crows-traits       --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:weapons: fvtt package pack -n crows-weapons      --in src/packs/crows-weapons      --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:armor: fvtt package pack -n crows-armor        --in src/packs/crows-armor        --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:gear: fvtt package pack -n crows-gear         --in src/packs/crows-gear         --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:consumables: fvtt package pack -n crows-consumables  --in src/packs/crows-consumables  --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:ammunition: fvtt package pack -n crows-ammunition   --in src/packs/crows-ammunition   --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:spellbooks: fvtt package pack -n crows-spellbooks   --in src/packs/crows-spellbooks   --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:monsters: fvtt package pack -n crows-monsters     --in src/packs/crows-monsters     --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:loot: fvtt package pack -n crows-loot         --in src/packs/crows-loot         --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.pack:rules: fvtt package pack -n crows-rules        --in src/packs/crows-rules        --out packs --yaml --type System --id crows
scripts.unpack: fvtt package unpack --in packs --out src/packs --yaml --type System --id crows
